Sitting Date:15-10-2012
Section Name:Second Reading Bills
Title:Personal Data Protection Bill
MPs Speaking:Dr Yaacob Ibrahim (Minister for Communications and Information), Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang), Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast), Mr Speaker

Personal Data Protection Bill

Order for Second Reading read.

3.10 pm

The Minister for Communications and Information (Dr Yaacob Ibrahim): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, “That the Bill be now read a Second time”.

The Minister for Communications and Information (Dr Yaacob Ibrahim): Mr Speaker, Sir, today, vast amounts of personal data are collected, used and transferred for a variety of reasons. This trend is expected to continue as new tools make it easier to process large amounts of such data. A regime to govern how organisations handle personal data is needed so that individuals can keep their trust in the way it is managed.

To date, Singapore has taken a sectoral approach to data protection. Several existing Acts contain secrecy and disclosure rules for the public sector.

The new law will protect personal data against misuse by setting rules for its management. Individuals will be told why organisations collect and use their data.
